p: LORD God: Therefore it should be excellent in all points.
affection to the house of my: His great zeal for the furtherance of the temple made him spare no expenses, but to bestow his own peculiar treasure.
three thousand talents of gold: He shows what he had of his own store for the Lord's house.
willing to consecrate his service this: He was not only liberal himself but provoked others to set forth the work of God.
found gave them to the treasure: Meaning, they who had any.
perfect heart they offered willingly to: That is, with good courage and without hypocrisy.
Israel our father: Who revealed yourself to our father Jacob.

come of thee: We gave you nothing of our own, but that which we have received from you: for whether the gifts are corporal or spiritual, we receive them all from God, and therefore must give him the glory.
strangers before thee: Therefore we have this land loaned to us for a time.
imagination of the thoughts of the: Continue then in his good mind, that they may serve you willingly.
king: That is, revered the king.
drink offerings: Meaning, all kinds of liquor which they mingled with their sacrifices, as wine, oil, etc.
throne of the LORD as king: This declares that the kings of Judah were figures of Christ, who was the true anointed, and to whom God gave the chief government of all things.
Nathan the prophet: The books of Nathan and Gad are thought to have been lost in the captivity.
times that went over him: Meaning the troubles and griefs.
